tokens.name: ground
tokens.usage: Page background. Basalt at night in Foundry, dusty regolith in Dune.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Plates: panels, task cards, the header bar. Always with a 1px `line` border.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Wells inside a plate: camera frames, episode thumbnails, code and log blocks, the readout track.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines, plate borders, the station track between stations. Decorative only; never the only thing marking a control.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Borders of inputs and secondary buttons. Holds 3:1 on `ground` and `surface` in both themes.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and numbers, on `ground`, `surface` and `surface-sunken`.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, metadata, captions under stations, on `ground`, `surface` and `surface-sunken`.

tokens.name: melt
tokens.usage: Molten metal. The brand colour: the AI in the wordmark, the one primary action per view, the station currently running. As text, on `ground`, `surface` and `melt-soft`.

tokens.name: melt-soft
tokens.usage: Tint behind `melt` text: the running-stage tag, the selected row.

tokens.name: on-melt
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a `melt` fill. Dark in Foundry, light in Dune; never hard-code white.

tokens.name: ochre
tokens.usage: Geonosis rock. Money and the data market: spend, payouts, prices on task cards, the budget meter fill. As text, on `surface`, `ground` and `ochre-soft`.

tokens.name: ochre-soft
tokens.usage: Tint behind `ochre` text: price chips, the purchased-episode tag.

tokens.name: arc
tokens.usage: Welding arc. Pass, live and shipped: eval successes, the live connection dot, the shipped tag, links, the focus ring. As text, on `ground`, `surface` and `arc-soft`.

tokens.name: arc-soft
tokens.usage: Tint behind `arc` text: the shipped tag, success trial chips.

tokens.name: on-arc
tokens.usage: Text on an `arc` fill.

tokens.name: slag
tokens.usage: Failure and danger only: failed trials, the failed tag, the soft e-stop. Always paired with a word (Fail, Failed, E-stop), never colour alone. As text, on `surface` and `slag-soft`.

tokens.name: slag-soft
tokens.usage: Tint behind `slag` text: failed tag, failed trial chips.

tokens.name: steel
tokens.usage: Droid steel. Idle and waiting: created, onboarding, queued, cancelled, an agent sleeping on a predicate. As text, on `surface` and `steel-soft`.

tokens.name: steel-soft
tokens.usage: Tint behind `steel` text.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus: a 2px solid ring offset 2px from the control. Holds 3:1 on every surface in both themes.

families.stencil: "Big Shoulders Stencil", "Big Shoulders", Impact, "Arial Narrow", sans-serif
families.mono: "IBM Plex Mono", ui-monospace, "SF Mono", Menlo, monospace

groups.name: Brand
groups.note: Big Shoulders Stencil, the letters stamped on a droid casing. The wordmark only.

styles.name: wordmark
styles.usage: The wordmark in the header. Uppercase. Never for headings or body copy.

styles.name: wordmark-hero
styles.usage: The wordmark on the demo title screen and the report cover.

groups.name: Display
groups.note: Big Shoulders, the condensed signage face of a factory floor. Headings and station labels.

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: One per screen at most: the landing hero, the report's headline result.

styles.name: display-l
styles.sample: Put the cup in the bin
styles.usage: Page titles: the ticket's task, the robot's name.

styles.name: station
styles.usage: Station labels on the line and status tags. Set uppercase.

groups.name: Text
groups.note: IBM Plex Sans for everything people read.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: The policy reaches the cup and fails in the last 5 cm.
styles.usage: Running text, planner decisions, task instructions.

styles.name: body-strong
styles.sample: Buy recovery takeovers, not clean demos.
styles.usage: The one sentence in a block that carries the decision.

groups.name: Data
groups.note: IBM Plex Mono with tabular figures. Every number a robot or a ledger produced.

styles.name: readout
styles.usage: The headline number of a readout: success rate, spend.

styles.name: data
styles.usage: Checkpoints, counts, money in tables, logs.

styles.name: id
styles.usage: Ticket, robot, episode and run ids.

spacing.note: 4px base. Plates use space-4 inside and space-6 between.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Rivet-to-label gap, inside tags.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Inside controls, between a label and its value.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Between related rows in a plate.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Plate padding; the page gutter on phones.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Between plates.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Between page sections; the page gutter on desktop.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Above the page title.

radius.note: Machined, not soft. Square plates with a hint of a break on the edge.

tokens.name: radius-0
tokens.usage: Rivets, the station track, the readout track.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Plates, tags, buttons, inputs: almost everything.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Camera frames and episode thumbnails.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Phone task cards only, where thumbs need a softer target.

shadow.note: Plates sit flat on the floor and are separated by borders. Shadows are for things that float.

tokens.name: shadow-overlay
tokens.usage: Menus, dialogs, the toast. Never on a plate.
